column_description: Unique identifier for each access event.
Reference to the film. may be NULL.
Reference to the user accessing the data. may be NULL.
Date when the data was accessed. may be NULL.
Type of access (e.g., view, edit). always exactly one of 'view', 'edit'. may be NULL.
IP address of the user accessing the data. may be NULL.
User agent string of the browser used. may be NULL.
Type of device used (e.g., desktop, mobile). always exactly one of 'desktop', 'mobile'. may be NULL.
